.

collocations: be agreed (on / about sth.) / be agreed (that...)：（对……）取得一致意
words.definition: 同意，赞成；答应，同意 vt.&vi. 商定；约定 vt. 批准，认可
words.etymology: 14世纪末, “to give consent, assent,” 来自古法语agreer “to please, satisfy; to receive with favor, take pleasure in” (12世纪), 词组a gré 的缩写形式， 含义为“favorably, of good will,” literally “to (one’s) liking” from a, 来自 拉丁语ad “to” (see ad-) +古法语gre, gret “that which pleases,” 来自拉丁 20000 词汇巅峰 速 记 笔 记 区 语gratum, neuter of gratus “pleasing, welcome, agreeable”（来自古印欧 语词根gwere-= “to favor”: 喜爱；恩惠；支持）。来自拉丁语gratum （令人愉快的）；所以该词字面义是“使人愉快”，引申到“赞成” 是比较抽象的，它的根义在agreeable（愉快的；宜人的）中更为明 显；同源词grace（优雅）、congratulate（祝贺；“同乐”）。
examples:
We agreed (that) the proposal was a good one.
我们一致认为这个建议不错。
It was agreed we should hold another meeting.
大家一致同意我们应该再开一次会。
I asked for a pay rise and she agreed.
我要求提高工资，她答应了。
Next year’s budget has been agreed.
明年的预算已获批准。
